trigger.description: No primer_cache row exists for the (workspace generation, config hash, budget, format) key, so the primer assembled fresh instead of serving cached bytes (ADR 0065 §3/§6). Any DB generation advance, config change, budget override, or format switch lands on this path once; the assembly persists the result so the next identical call is a byte-identical cache hit.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Always run the verify script before pushing.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json

notes: Informational by design: cold is the normal first-call state and after every memory write. Agents should never retry on this code; the warm-hit latency contract (<100ms) only applies to the cached path, which the very same call just warmed.
